MEASURED, NOT ASSUMED — ALL CAPITAL RULES ARE INERT AND HAVE BEEN REMOVED. Epitran case-folds before matching: Ⲍ (capital zata, with NO rule of its own) transliterates to 'z' from the lowercase ⲍ rule alone. So the 9 capitals in the first draft and the 7 added with the Demotic letters did nothing, and 15 further capitals would have done nothing either. Removed rather than completed — 16 inert rows are 16 more values a reviewer has to read. ⚠ Do not re-add them without re-running that probe; if a future Epitran stops folding, every capital becomes a silent gap at once.

THE REMAINING 2% — THE SUPRALINEAR STROKE. After this fix 347/347 Demotic-bearing rows emit no Coptic letter, and 340/347 (98.0%) are fully PanPhon-parseable. The 7 that are not carry U+0305 COMBINING OVERLINE, the supralinear stroke that marks a syllabic consonant (e.g. ϩⲱⲕⲉⲛ̅ⲡⲓⲛ). It is a real phonological mark, not decoration, and mapping it needs a decision about how to represent syllabicity — left unmapped deliberately.
